shared_elements: horizontal band filled with repeated short vertical strokes (comb-like/fringe motif)
motifs stacked in loose horizontal registers on a flat rock surface
small isolated animal or creature forms scattered in the field
elongated curving line ending in a raised terminal (boat prow / snake body)
repeated small rounded units in a row (dots / arched shapes)
justification: The most specific correspondence is the recurring horizontal band bearing a row of short parallel vertical strokes, which appears in the boat-crew lines of A and the carved fringe register of B, and both surfaces distribute several discrete motifs in loosely stacked registers. Otherwise they are quite unlike: A is a flat, two-dimensional silhouette in dark line on pale stone dominated by boats and stick figures, while B is a three-dimensional low relief with modelled, recognisable animals (quadrupeds, birds, a snake) on a shaped pillar.
